title: Unreachable condition check in Ack::from_bytes_for
description: Lines 372-373: `if n > WINDOW_SIZE { return Err(...) }` - This condition can never be true. n = WINDOW_SIZE - trailing, where trailing = (bitmap & BITMAP_MASK).trailing_ones(). Since BITMAP_MASK has only 63 bits set, trailing_ones returns at most 63 = WINDOW_SIZE. Therefore n >= 0 always, and n <= WINDOW_SIZE always. Should be debug_assert!(n <= WINDOW_SIZE) to document the invariant without dead code.
